name: cape_jkg_binding_contribution
description: v2.1 candidate (Unreleased): cape_jkg binds when capeContrib > 0 and lifts effective_instability under additive aggregation. Base TV-001 modified to wind_now=18 (band 11–18, score 10), rain_prob=30 (rule_1, score 10), instability_index=0.10 (low so CAPE is the binding signal). With cape_jkg=2000 (mid-to-upper segment): cape_contrib = 0.4 + (2000−1500)/1000 × (0.8−0.4) = 0.6. effective_instability = min(1, 0.10 + 0.6) = 0.7. Δ instComp = (0.7−0.10) × 20 = +12. Δ raw via wts.instability=0.10: +1.2. weather_now baseline 3.0 → 4.2 with CAPE. risk_score baseline = round(9 + 3.0 + 6) = 18 (R0); with CAPE = round(9 + 4.2 + 6) = 19 (R0). Decision GO both ways — channel is intrinsically narrow (×0.10 weight), test proves wiring not R-level transition. Cannot use TV-001's input verbatim because predDisc=−5.1 floors weather_now at 0 in both states. Spec: §5.2.7 (Unreleased).
